---
title: "Conciliación"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Conciliación bancaria</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Certifica el saldo real a una fecha, resuelve diferencias y conserva una trazabilidad reversible.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
</div>

<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2">
  <section class="tf-card">
    <h2>Conciliar cuenta</h2>
    <form id="recn-form" class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="recn-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="recn-date" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Saldo informado por banco ($)</label><input id="recn-bank-balance" type="number" step="0.01" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Nota</label><input id="recn-note" placeholder="Opcional"></div>
      <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar conciliación</button></div>
    </form>
    <div id="recn-result" class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="tf-card tf-recovery-card">
    <div class="tf-section-kicker">Perdí el hilo de seguimiento</div>
    <h2>Recuperar período</h2>
    <p class="tf-muted">Usa el saldo real como fuente de verdad. Tracker crea solo la diferencia como <strong>Por clasificar</strong>.</p>
    <form id="recover-form" class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta</label><select id="recover-account"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Última fecha confiable</label><input id="recover-start" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha del saldo real</label><input id="recover-end" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Saldo real actual ($)</label><input id="recover-bank-balance" type="number" step="0.01" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Nota</label><input id="recover-note" placeholder="Ej. Semana sin registrar gastos"></div>
      <div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Calcular y recuperar</button></div>
    </form>
    <div id="recover-preview" class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
  </section>
</div>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <div class="tf-section-heading">
    <div>
      <h2>Ajustes por clasificar</h2>
      <div class="tf-muted">Reclasificar no cambia el saldo: solo divide el mismo ajuste entre categorías reales.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="recover-adjustments"></div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <div class="tf-section-heading">
    <div>
      <h2>Historial de conciliaciones</h2>
      <div class="tf-muted">Editar o eliminar recalcula únicamente el ajuste vinculado. Las conciliaciones posteriores quedan marcadas para revisión.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-table-wrap">
    <table class="tf-table tf-reconciliation-table">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Fecha</th>
          <th>Cuenta</th>
          <th>Antes</th>
          <th>Banco</th>
          <th>Ajuste</th>
          <th>Después</th>
          <th>Estado</th>
          <th>Clasificación</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="recn-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<dialog id="recn-edit-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog">
  <form id="recn-edit-form">
    <div class="tf-modal-head">
      <div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Editar conciliación</div><h2 id="recn-edit-title">Conciliación</h2></div>
      <button type="button" class="tf-icon-button" data-close-edit aria-label="Cerrar">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Cuenta</label><input id="recn-edit-account" disabled></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="recn-edit-date" type="date" required></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Saldo banco ($)</label><input id="recn-edit-bank" type="number" step="0.01" required></div>
      <div id="recn-edit-recovery-wrap" class="tf-field tf-span-2" hidden>
        <label>Última fecha confiable</label><input id="recn-edit-recovery-start" type="date">
      </div>
      <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Nota</label><input id="recn-edit-note"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-alert tf-alert-info is-visible" style="margin-top:.8rem">
      Si cambia el monto del ajuste, las clasificaciones existentes se reinician para no alterar el total conciliado.
    </div>
    <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:1rem">
      <button type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-close-edit>Cancelar</button>
      <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar cambios</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<dialog id="recn-classify-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog">
  <form id="recn-classify-form">
    <div class="tf-modal-head">
      <div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Reclasificar ajuste</div><h2 id="recn-classify-title">Ajuste</h2></div>
      <button type="button" class="tf-icon-button" data-close-classify aria-label="Cerrar">×</button>
    </div>
    <div id="recn-classify-summary" class="tf-subtle" style="margin-bottom:1rem"></div>
    <div class="tf-form-grid">
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría</label><select id="recn-classify-category"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Subcategoría</label><select id="recn-classify-subcategory"></select></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Monto a clasificar ($)</label><input id="recn-classify-amount" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:1rem">
      <button type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-close-classify>Cancelar</button>
      <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Aplicar clasificación</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/reconciliation.js"></script>
```
